llc.formation_notes: Filed online with the Secretary of State.

annual_report.name: Annual Report (Form F0108)
annual_report.due: between January 1 and April 15 each year, online only
annual_report.late_penalty: may lead to administrative dissolution; reinstatement $50

sources.title: MS Secretary of State Business Documents Filing Fees
sources.quote: F0100 MS LLC Certificate of Formation $50 ... F0108 MS LLC Annual Report $0 ... F0109 LLC Reinstatement $50

sources.title: MS SOS Annual Reports
sources.quote: The Annual Report for profit corporations and limited liability companies can be filed any time on or after January 1st of each year and are due by April 15th

entity_level_taxes.name: Franchise tax (all S corporations, incl. LLCs taxed as S corps)
entity_level_taxes.notes: Tax years beginning in 2026: $0.50 per $1,000 of capital employed above $100,000 (or assessed property value if greater), minimum $25. Drops to $0.25 in 2027.

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Partnerships and S corps may elect (Form 84-381) to be taxed at entity level since 2022; rate follows the individual rate (not stated in the FAQ read).

sources.title: MS DOR Business Tax FAQ
sources.quote: For tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2026, but before January 1, 2027, Franchise tax is computed at $0.50 per $1,000 ... In no case shall the franchise tax computed be less than $25.

sources.title: MS DOR Electing Pass-Through Entity FAQ (2024)
sources.quote: For calendar year 2022 and each calendar year thereafter, any partnership, S Corporation or similar pass-through entity can elect to be treated as an electing pass-through entity.

sources.title: MS DOR Business Tax FAQ
sources.quote: All S Corporations are subject to franchise tax which is taxed and paid at the entity level.

personal_exemption.notes: Head of family $8,000; each dependent/65+/blind $1,500. Joint filers: the first $10,000 of EACH spouse's taxable income is exempt, so the MFJ table applies per spouse. Standard deduction HOH $3,400.

sources.title: MS DOR Individual Income Tax rates, exemptions and deductions
sources.quote: Tax Year 2026 Excess of $10,000 of Taxable Income is taxed @ 4%

sources.title: MS DOR Individual FAQ
sources.quote: If married filing joint, the first $10,000 of each taxpayer's taxable income is exempt

estimated_tax.required_if: annual tax liability exceeds $200 and less than 80% is prepaid through withholding
estimated_tax.notes: Payments must total at least 80% of the annual liability (Form 80-106).

unemployment_2026.notes: Start-up rate 1.00% first year, 1.10% second, 1.20% third, excluding the Workforce Investment and Training contribution. Wage base not stated on the MDES page read.

notable: Rate cut to 4% on taxable income above $10,000 in 2026, then 3.75% in 2027 (https://www.dor.ms.gov/individual/tax-rates)
LLC annual report is free; formation $50 (https://www.sos.ms.gov/sites/default/files/business-services/FeeSchedule.pdf)
Electing S corp status brings the corporate franchise tax ($25 minimum, $0.50 per $1,000 of capital over $100,000 in 2026) (https://www.dor.ms.gov/business/business-tax-frequently-asked-questions)
uncertain: MFJ: the 0% band applies to each spouse's own first $10,000 of taxable income; the bracket table is per spouse, not a doubled joint band.
Elective PTE tax rate not stated in the official FAQ read.
SUTA taxable wage base for 2026 not found on the MDES page (web search budget exhausted).
The DOR page sentence 'In 2026, the graduated 2025 tax year income tax rate is ... 4.4%' refers to returns filed in 2026 for tax year 2025; tax year 2026 is 4%.
